qa.notes: Start Postgres first with `docker-compose up -d`, then `npm run setup` to generate the client and migrate. Copy .env.example to .env: JWT_SECRET must be set or every request 401s, and FINNHUB_API_KEY must be set or every US equity fails to price and the dashboard suppresses the total rather than showing a partial one. Upstash and Telegram can stay unset — the cache degrades to live fetches and alerts are skipped. There is no seed account; sign up at /signup, then add holdings from /holdings. A MANUAL holding needs a value entered or it prices as a failure by design.
